claims.text: Asthma: low-dose ICS–formoterol is the preferred reliever at every step (as needed in mild asthma; maintenance + reliever in moderate–severe persistent);
claims.quote: There is substantial evidence that the preferred reliever across all steps is a low-dose ICS–beta-agonist combination, used as needed for mild asthma and as both maintenance and reliever therapy for moderate-to-severe persistent asthma

claims.text: formoterol with an ICS may be dosed every 3–4 h by some protocols.
claims.quote: except for formoterol, which in combination with an inhaled glucocorticoid may be dosed every 3 to 4 hours according to some protocols

claims.quote: Inhaled combination therapy with glucocorticoids, long-acting beta-2 agonists, and long-acting muscarinic antagonists are recommended for the maintenance treatment of asthma for severe persistent asthma (step 5) in adults

claims.text: ↑ pneumonia risk in COPD (higher in patients > 65 y).
claims.quote: The incidence of pneumonia in the subjects treated with ADVAIR DISKUS was higher in subjects older than 65 years (9%) compared with the incidence in subjects younger than 65 years (4%).

claims.text: Contraindicated as primary treatment of status asthmaticus or acute asthma/COPD needing intensive measures; fluticasone/salmeterol DPI also in severe milk-protein allergy.
claims.quote: • Primary treatment of status asthmaticus or acute episodes of asthma or COPD requiring intensive measures. ( 4 ) • Severe hypersensitivity to milk proteins or demonstrated hypersensitivity to fluticasone propionate, salmeterol, or any of the excipients. ( 4 )

claims.text: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (eg, ritonavir, clarithromycin, itraconazole, ketoconazole): not recommended (↑ systemic steroid and cardiovascular effects).
claims.quote: The use of strong cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4) inhibitors (e.g., ritonavir, atazanavir, clarithromycin, indinavir, itraconazole, nefazodone, nelfinavir, saquinavir, ketoconazole, telithromycin) with ADVAIR DISKUS is not recommended because increased systemic corticosteroid and increased cardiovascular adverse effects may occur
claims.locator: 5.9 Drug Interactions with Strong Cytochrome P450 3A4 Inhibitors

claims.text: Rising SABA use = deteriorating asthma: reassess the regimen.
claims.quote: Increasing use of inhaled, short-acting beta 2 -agonists is a marker of deteriorating asthma. In this situation, the patient requires immediate reevaluation with reassessment of the treatment regimen
claims.locator: 5.2 Deterioration of Disease and Acute Episodes

claims.text: In COPD, watch for pneumonia (its features overlap with exacerbations).
claims.quote: Physicians should remain vigilant for the possible development of pneumonia in patients with COPD as the clinical features of pneumonia and exacerbations frequently overlap.

claims.text: Rinse mouth with water without swallowing after each use.
claims.quote: After inhalation, the patient should rinse his/her mouth with water without swallowing to help reduce the risk of oropharyngeal candidiasis.

claims.text: Don't exceed the prescribed inhalations (mometasone/formoterol: no more than two inhalations twice daily).
claims.quote: Do not use more than two inhalations twice daily of the prescribed strength of DULERA

claims.text: Improvement can start within 15 min, but full benefit may take 2 weeks or longer.
claims.quote: Improvement in asthma control following inhaled administration of SYMBICORT can occur within 15 minutes of beginning treatment, although maximum benefit may not be achieved for 2 weeks or longer after beginning treatment.
